name: Nagase Sayaka
source:
Sayaka is enrolled in the third year program of Central Military Academy's preparatory division. She is an active, outgoing girl who clearly displays her feelings. Since she's straightforward and mindful of others, many come to rely on her. Her goal is to be a fighter pilot and she holds licenses to operate almost every vehicle.
